problems.what: every line of prose is 30 px on a 1920 frame (about 6 px in a phone feed): 'a right triangle', 'same square / same four triangles' and the Babylonian end line, the one historical fact in the film, cannot be read

problems.what: nothing lands with a punch: the four triangles settle on the slow tail of the S-curve and the c², a², b² holes fade in over 16-20 frames, so the moments the proof turns on read as more gliding (0 abrupt changes in 32 s, 78% near-still)
problems.fix: a snap as each triangle lands (a quick flash and settle, with its tick) and hard reveals of the holes: full fill on the frame the last piece lands, with a white flash that decays, and a tick

problems.what: in the side swap the '=' slides straight through 'a²' and 'c²' passes over it at the start (frame 1290 reads 'c²' on top of '=a²', frame 1296 'a²=+')

problems.what: the three-sample 180° blur prints three distinct copies on the triangle flights, the rearranging triangles and the flying '5²' (a triple '5' at frame 1575)

problems.what: the triangle and the claim figure sit in the upper 45% of the frame; the lower half is empty slate for eight seconds
problems.fix: lower the vertical figure and its equation so the group centres in the safe area

rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)
fixed: the hook asks the question: 'Why is a² + b² = c² ?' (in the quantity colours, 80 px landscape, 92 px vertical) is outlined from frame 0 and complete by 0.6 s, with a tick on beat 1 (frame 40); 'a right triangle' sits under it at 44 px; both fade by frame 226, before the claim builds its own equation out of the squares
prose is 44 px in both sizes: the landscape comparison line is one line under the squares, the end line breaks into two lines (landscape) and three (vertical), spaced from the prose size

punch: each triangle snaps as it lands in the square (an instant flash that decays in about 6 frames, 1.04× growth); the c² hole fills on the frame the fourth triangle lands (760) with a white flash and a hit; in the rearrangement triangles 1 and 3 land on beat 23 (a² hole revealed hard, tick) and triangle 0 on beat 24 (b² hole revealed hard, tick)
the side swap lifts the terms off the baseline early and sends c² over '=' at a different height, so no term slides through another
motion blur samples 3 to 7: the flights and the 180° turns read as a smear, not three copies
vertical: the hook group and the claim figure moved down (triangle centre 660 to 880, claim figure 560 to 700, equation 1080 to 1230, end group about 70 px lower)

the re-timing left dead air at 962-1000 and 1115-1151 at first; the 'same square' and 'same four triangles' indications now play as each phrase writes (976, 1016) and the dimming runs 1060-1139, so still-frames is clean
